# `get_camera_exp_and_bin`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Read the current exposure value and bin factor.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | MUTATOR / established (64-bit build; 32-bit build established) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, handler @0xbc3a0 (64-bit build) |

Params are not read. Returns {exposure, bin}; neither is emitted unless both queries succeed. exposure is an integer number of microseconds.

Side effects: On page 1 it lazily refreshes the shared video bin and subframe cache (not a hardware setter) and may block on locks.

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 318 | Required camera is closed | `device not connected` |
| 207 | Operation failure whose thread-local error code is zero (the default substituted when the callee set none); other callee-set codes are forwarded unchanged | `fail to operate` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

The first failing query forwards its thread-local error.

## Example

Request, request:

```json
{"id":47,"method":"get_camera_exp_and_bin"}
```

Reply, ok:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_camera_exp_and_bin","result":{"exposure":10000,"bin":1},"code":0,"id":47}
```

Reply, error:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_camera_exp_and_bin","error":"device not connected","code":318,"id":48}
```
